scope: Independent review of the fresh publication snapshot, protected-source additions and article/reference guards; not a deployment or broad legal-survey review.

tests.execution: Run independently by this reviewer against the hashed code/test version.

checks: Every one of the 295 previously public routes and 3,884 anchors is represented in the actual snapshot and remains present.
Reference preservation now covers every currently published guide, including last round’s 17 additions/promotions. Snapshot validation also rejects loss of saved source/rule references.

A changed protected article body requires a recorded integration since the snapshot and a matching independent content/decision review before publication. Date comparisons parse timestamps rather than relying on text order.
Configured malformed/empty/duplicate publication snapshots fail before mutation. The selected path is confined to the research JSON namespace.

Original snapshot source/rule IDs extend duplicate-addition protection to all 741 sources and 418 rules from the last release. A refresh cannot silently overwrite those records; explicit updates remain supported.
New in-progress additions can still be corrected through explicit refresh, while changed decision fingerprints invalidate stale article approval.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Root added configured snapshot shape/date/identity checks and targeted failures.
Root added current publication record IDs to the protected-addition set and a regression test for a source published after the original baseline.

limits: This review covers the actual frozen publication snapshot and importer guard. Root owns the full build, browser tests, deployment and live verification.
